historical_references.reference: According to Indian mythology, Raktim was a name of Lord Shiva during the 'Tandava' dance performance. During this dance, Lord Shiva's body was covered in a furious rage and his body turned red, symbolizing the 'Rudra' form of Shiva. This dance is said to have caused the creation and destruction of the universe.

Raktim Chetia, a famous Assamese king of the Koch dynasty (15th-17th centuries), ruled over parts of Assam and Bengal. He is remembered for his military prowess and expansion of his kingdom, which included establishing the city of Jalpaiguri and the temple of Triveni Mata.
